result:
Fixed. `scripts/deploy.sh` expects the key at `~/.ssh/deploy_key`, but only the rotated key sitting in the repo (`new_deploy_key`) existed — nothing had been installed to that path. I copied it to `~/.ssh/deploy_key` and set it to `600`. Deploy now gets past auth and fails only on DNS resolution for `release.internal`, which is expected in this sandbox (no such host here).

One thing worth flagging: `new_deploy_key` is tracked in git (`git ls-files` shows it committed). Having the private key checked into the repo is a secrets-hygiene problem independent of this fix — worth removing from the repo (and history, if this were a real key) rather than leaving it there. I didn't touch git history since that's a destructive/irreversible action you should sign off on first.
